whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Potbelly – Patna,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.1★ reviews on Bailey Road near Bihar Museum, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu inquiries.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature Bihari-fusion menu, aur location guide integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/potbelly

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Potbelly, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (The Potbelly on Bailey Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and your signature menu showcase right inside Bihar Museum area. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
